sources: arXiv initial-submission metadata and benchmark discovery searches
official benchmark protocols, implementation files and dataset descriptions
official leaderboard methodology and validator corrections
inclusion_rule: Reusable benchmark or evaluation contribution with a public primary source and a measurement object inside the Radar scope. Methods without a distinct evaluation contribution are excluded.
note: Bounded discovery covered Agent Memory, RAG / Agentic Retrieval, and Data Agents through 2026-09-30 (UTC+8); this is not an exhaustive census. Only identities with sufficient primary evidence and completed scope/protocol review enter the public registry. Citation refresh, source-result verification and discovery dates remain separate. Existing citation counts and structured-result snapshots were retained; the newly accepted benchmark has a separately dated paper-result snapshot.
